headline: Kai, the market is trying to hold two thoughts at once — an AI trade at record highs, and a Gulf standoff that just put Brent back above $100.
subline: The Nasdaq closed at a record on Meta and the chip rally, Treasury moves to ground Iran's airlines by Wednesday, and three Fed speakers fill the tape today.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:35 AM ET · equity figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Nasdaq sets a record; S&P 500 nears one
items.sentence: Monday ended with the Nasdaq up 2.3 percent at a record 27,122, the S&P 500 up 1.5 percent to 7,764.70 and the Dow up 0.7 percent, per the AP's wrap on Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Three Fed speakers today, flash PMIs Wednesday
items.sentence: Kiplinger's calendar has New York's John Williams at 10:05, Vice Chair Philip Jefferson at 10:20 and Richmond's Tom Barkin at 1 p.m., ahead of September's preliminary PMI readings tomorrow.

items.title: Brent back above $101 as Washington squeezes
items.sentence: Brent rose 1.05 percent to $101.39 on the Treasury's new Iran measures while WTI eased to $92.61, per Benzinga's premarket brief, and AutoZone, KB Home and Thor Industries report today.

items.title: Berkshire discloses a $1.2 billion Lennar stake
items.sentence: Benzinga reports the position in the homebuilder was disclosed under CEO Greg Abel, and Lennar added about 1 percent in premarket trade.

items.title: Bitcoin holds the rebound at $85,000
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades at $85,435, up 2 percent overnight after Monday's 6 percent surge carried it briefly past $86,000 alongside the AI rally, per Yahoo Finance's live blogs.

items.title: Treasury moves to ground Iran's airlines worldwide
items.sentence: Scott Bessent said Iranian carriers will be shut down worldwide by Wednesday, with financial institutions in Egypt, Turkey and Russia sanctioned for facilitating Tehran's transactions, per Benzinga.

items.title: Qatar works to keep the ceasefire alive
items.sentence: Iran International's live coverage has Doha pressing for a renewed US-Iran deal after two more ships were hit and Tehran issued a fresh threat.

items.title: Xi's visit this week now runs through AI
items.sentence: Bessent called preliminary US-China talks 'very successful,' per Yahoo Finance, with the Trump-Xi capstone meeting this week centered on artificial-intelligence cooperation.

items.title: Trump floats an AI czar and 'AI Force'
items.sentence: AI Weekly's digest reports the president vowed to appoint an AI czar and stand up an 'AI Force' modeled on the Space Force.

items.title: Meta's Muse tops the App Store
items.sentence: Meta rose 11 percent after its Muse assistant reached the App Store's top spot, per Yahoo Finance, a move traders read as bullish for chip demand heading into this week's Connect event.

items.title: AMD joins the trillion-dollar club
items.sentence: AMD gained 10 percent to an all-time high above $610 and a $1 trillion market cap, with Intel up 12 percent and Arm up 10, per Yahoo Finance's Monday blog.

items.title: Accenture pairs with Anthropic on AI safety
items.sentence: Benzinga reports a new collaboration focused on AI safety and model evaluation, alongside an expanded Accenture-Google Cloud partnership with Volvo Cars as its lead Horizon partner.

items.title: Alibaba claims China's most powerful AI chip
items.sentence: The Zhenwu V900 debuts with plans for a multi-trillion-parameter Qwen successor and 20 gigawatts of data-center capacity by 2032, per AI Weekly's roundup.
